would.sentenceEn: Taking out those parking spots, as they argued at protests and in letters to the city council, would ruin stores and restaurants along Skillman.
would.translationZh: 正如他们在抗议活动中以及给市议会的信函中所主张的那样，取消这些停车位会毁掉斯基尔曼大街沿线的商店和餐馆。

would.sentenceEn: Five years ago, the city of Queens, New York, announced that it would be putting bike lanes onto a stretch of Skillman Ave — and removing 116 parking spots.
would.translationZh: 五年前，纽约市皇后区宣布，将在斯基尔曼大道的部分路段增设自行车道，并为此取消 116 个停车位。

would.sentenceEn: M: Yeah, the classrooms would probably smell like paint, making the air in the school all stuffy.
would.translationZh: 是啊，教室里可能会有一股油漆味，让学校里的空气变得特别沉闷。
would.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

would.sentenceEn: They have a reputation of being overly strict with the students, not to mention the overwhelming amount of homework they assign, which would lead to a lot of pressure for Jake and me.
would.translationZh: 他们出了名的对学生过于严厉，更不用说布置的海量作业了，这会给杰克和我带来巨大的压力。
would.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

would.sentenceEn: Local business owners on Skillman Ave argued that their businesses would be ruined when parking spots were replaced by bike lanes.
would.translationZh: 斯基尔曼大道上的当地商家认为，如果停车位被自行车道取代，他们的生意将会遭到毁灭性的打击。

would.sentenceEn: They focused on the benefits young people would reap in the future.
would.translationZh: 他们专注于年轻人未来将获得的益处。

wrong.sentenceEn: There's nothing wrong with trying to look our best, but excessive focus on physical appearance misses the soulful aspects of what it means to be beautiful.
wrong.translationZh: 努力展现自己最好的一面无可厚非，但过度关注外表会忽略美丽的灵魂层面。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

wrong.sentenceEn: This may contribute to the deep fear that we will make the wrong decision.
wrong.translationZh: 这可能会加剧我们内心深处对做错决定的恐惧。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

wrong.sentenceEn: Taking medicine at the wrong time can even cause harm.
wrong.translationZh: 在错误的时间服药甚至可能对身体造成伤害。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

wrong.sentenceEn: By relying on facts and data, you minimize your potential for a wrong decision.
wrong.translationZh: 依靠事实和数据，你可以最大限度地降低决策失误的风险。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

wrong.sentenceEn: How do smart people react when they are found to be wrong ?
wrong.translationZh: 当聪明人被发现犯错时，他们会作何反应？

wrong.sentenceEn: Why it's wrong to look at work-life balance as an achievement
wrong.translationZh: 为何将工作生活平衡视为一种成就的想法是错误的

workplace.sentenceEn: But for volunteering to benefit employees and the workplace , the entire organization needs to be involved.
workplace.translationZh: 但要让志愿服务真正惠及员工和工作场所，就需要整个组织的参与。
workplace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

workplace.sentenceEn: By allowing employees to donate their time during work hours, the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment without affecting personal time.
workplace.translationZh: 允许员工在工作时间内贡献自己的时间，能让工作场所成为实现个人价值的渠道，同时不占用个人时间。
workplace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

workplace.sentenceEn: According to the new rules, students of Taverham are required to wear smart black shoes appropriate for the workplace , Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior.
workplace.translationZh: 根据新规定，塔弗姆学校的学生必须穿着适合职场的正式黑色皮鞋。哈里斯认为，加强校服管理规定能够改善学生的学习成绩和行为表现。
workplace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

workplace.sentenceEn: Businesses are waking up to the skills gamers can bring to the workplace .
workplace.translationZh: 企业界逐渐意识到玩家能为职场带来的技能优势。

workplace.sentenceEn: Some people view socializing at the workplace as a chance to develop personal relationships.
workplace.translationZh: 有些人将职场社交视为发展个人关系的机会。

workplace.sentenceEn: More and more people in the workplace find it hard to rely on traditional pensions.
workplace.translationZh: 职场中越来越多的人发现，依靠传统的退休金已变得愈发困难。

wild.sentenceEn: The most recent count of pandas found that there were more than 1,800 left in the wild , putting them on the list of vulnerable, but not endangered, species.
wild.translationZh: 最新的大熊猫数量统计显示，野外生存的大熊猫超过1800只，这使它们被列为易危物种，但尚未达到濒危级别。
wild.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

wild.sentenceEn: Most of the coverage of the boom in wild camping has been negative.
wild.translationZh: 关于野外露营热潮的报道大多持负面态度。
wild.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

wild.sentenceEn: It would make sense that wild campers need to ask for permission to camp from landowners, especially outside Scotland, where the law is far more restrictive.
wild.translationZh: 野外露营者需要获得土地所有者的露营许可，这是合情合理的，尤其是在苏格兰以外地区，那里的法律限制要严格得多。
wild.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wild.sentenceEn: Supporters call it " wild camping"; opponents call it "illegal camping".
wild.translationZh: 支持者称之为“野外露营”；反对者则称之为“非法露营”。
wild.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wild.sentenceEn: Why has wild camping become popular in the UK?
wild.translationZh: 为什么野外露营在英国变得流行起来？

wild.sentenceEn: It was a shelter for wild animals.
wild.translationZh: 这里曾是野生动物的庇护所。

writing.sentenceEn: His writing is more than a little dense—dense with research, clauses, and precise adjectives and nouns.
writing.translationZh: 他的作品相当晦涩——充满了研究内容、从句以及精准的形容词和名词。
writing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

writing.sentenceEn: But there's also humor and enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing.
writing.translationZh: 但其中也不乏幽默元素和足够多有趣的情节，使作品颇具吸引力。
writing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

writing.sentenceEn: You can talk to a best-selling author about writing , but the only way to become a better writer is to practice publishing consistently.
writing.translationZh: 你可以与畅销书作家探讨写作，但成为更优秀作家的唯一途径是坚持练习发表作品。

writing.sentenceEn: But surely all this short-form writing is affecting literacy?
writing.translationZh: 但可以肯定的是，所有这些简短形式的写作正在影响读写能力吗？

writing.sentenceEn: What does the author think of Ford's writing ?
writing.translationZh: 作者如何看待福特的写作？

writing.sentenceEn: They learned the techniques of collaborative writing .
writing.translationZh: 他们学习了协作写作的技巧。

working.sentenceEn: The real workings of grit are to have sustainable passion and continue to try.
working.translationZh: 坚毅的真正内涵在于拥有持久的热情并不断尝试。
working.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

working.sentenceEn: In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being.
working.translationZh: 在一项调查中，89%的员工认为赞助志愿活动的公司能创造更好的工作环境，75%的员工表示志愿服务对他们的幸福感至关重要。
working.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

working.sentenceEn: In 1930 the average working week was 47 hours in the United States.
working.translationZh: 1930年，美国的平均每周工作时长为47小时。

working.sentenceEn: This can be seen in the median worker's income over this time period, complete with a shift in 1973 that fits in precisely with when the working week stopped shrinking.
working.translationZh: 这一点可以从这段时期工人的收入中位数看出，其中1973年的变化与工作周停止缩短的时间点恰好吻合。

working.sentenceEn: Friedman believes inequality in the U.S. largely explains why increasing productivity has not resulted in reduced working hours.
working.translationZh: 弗里德曼认为，美国的不平等现象在很大程度上解释了为什么生产力提高却没有带来工作时间的减少。

working.sentenceEn: Employees can benefit as much from remote working as their employers.
working.translationZh: 员工可以像他们的雇主一样从远程工作中获益良多。

warning.sentenceEn: " Warning fatigue" and distracted driving are also causes for concern.
warning.translationZh: "警告疲劳"和分心驾驶也令人担忧。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

warning.sentenceEn: For example, a driver, annoyed after receiving continuous warnings , could decide to just ignore the message.
warning.translationZh: 例如，一名司机在收到持续警告后感到厌烦，可能会决定直接无视这条信息。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

warning.sentenceEn: Orange warnings are in force for many areas for Wednesday and Thursday.
warning.translationZh: 许多地区已针对周三和周四发布橙色预警。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

warning.sentenceEn: Why do so many Americans eat tons of processed food, the stuff that is correctly called junk(垃圾) and should really carry warning labels?
warning.translationZh: 为什么这么多美国人吃大量加工食品——那些被准确称为垃圾食品、真的应该贴警告标签的东西？

warning.sentenceEn: What would drivers do when they suffer from " warning fatigue"?
warning.translationZh: 当驾驶员遭遇“警报疲劳”时，他们会怎么做？

warning.sentenceEn: Take no action despite repeated warnings .
warning.translationZh: 屡经警告仍不采取行动。

workforce.sentenceEn: In the long term, however, the same people see machines as more threatening to their future role in the workforce .
workforce.translationZh: 然而，从长远来看，这些人认为机器对他们未来在劳动力市场中的角色构成了更大的威胁。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

workforce.sentenceEn: In the baseline condition, participants saw emails in the normal format, with no information on diversity; in the diversity condition, participants saw a diversity score for each listing: information about the race, gender, education, and language skills of a company's workforce compared to others in the same sector and location.
workforce.translationZh: 在基准条件下，参与者看到的是正常格式的电子邮件，没有任何多样性信息；在多样性条件下，参与者会看到每个职位的多样性评分：该评分展示了公司员工在种族、性别、教育背景和语言技能方面与同行业同地区其他公司的对比情况。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

workforce.sentenceEn: W: But it's not always easy to get back into the workforce after an extended absence.
workforce.translationZh: 但长时间脱离职场后，要重新回归并不总是那么容易。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

workforce.sentenceEn: Technology companies have an interest in developing a workforce with the STEM (science, technology, engineering and math) skills needed to grow the company and advance the industry.
workforce.translationZh: 科技公司有兴趣培养具备STEM（科学、技术、工程和数学）技能的劳动力，这些技能是公司发展和行业进步所必需的。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

workforce.sentenceEn: Over 70% of male educators who said they intended to stay in the early education workforce noted an increased salary was a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term.
workforce.translationZh: 在表示打算继续留在幼儿教育领域的男性教育工作者中，超过70%的人指出，薪资提高是促使他们长期从事这一职业的主要因素。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

workforce.sentenceEn: They have been successful in preparing the workforce for companies.
workforce.translationZh: 他们在为企业培养劳动力方面取得了成功。

willing.sentenceEn: This means people are less willing to collaborate with them.
willing.translationZh: 这意味着人们不太愿意与他们合作。
willing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

willing.sentenceEn: The person who worked in the bank is more likely ready, willing and able to be part of the team and do the job from day 1.
willing.translationZh: 曾在银行工作过的人通常更有可能在入职第一天就准备就绪，不仅有主观意愿，且具备胜任团队工作所需的能力。

willing.sentenceEn: And the team also found that participants were willing to look at listings with lower salaries if they came from companies with a higher diversity score.
willing.translationZh: 研究团队还发现，如果职位来自多元化评分较高的公司，参与者愿意考虑薪资较低的职位。
willing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

willing.sentenceEn: A new study finds that job seekers are even willing to explore jobs with lower salaries when companies are more diverse.
willing.translationZh: 一项新研究发现，当公司更加多元化时，求职者甚至愿意考虑薪资更低的工作。
willing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

willing.sentenceEn: When are job seekers willing to explore jobs with lower salaries, according to a new study?
willing.translationZh: 根据一项新研究，求职者在什么情况下愿意考虑薪资较低的工作？

willing.sentenceEn: They are more willing to risk their own lives.
willing.translationZh: 他们更愿意拿自己的生命去冒险。

wallet.sentenceEn: Although he only had three dollars in his wallet , at least he was driving in the right direction.
wallet.translationZh: 虽然他钱包里只有三美元，但至少他行驶的方向是对的。
wallet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

wallet.sentenceEn: Because of social categorization, you immediately judge the woman as harmless, and the man as threatening, leading to the loss of your wallet .
wallet.translationZh: 由于社会分类，你立即判断那位女士是无害的，而那位男士是有威胁的，结果导致了钱包的丢失。
wallet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

wallet.sentenceEn: Doesn't a wallet —that time-honoured Friday-night feeling of pleasing, promising fatness—represent something that matters?
wallet.translationZh: 钱包——那种由来已久的周五晚上令人愉悦、充满希望的厚实感——难道不代表着某种重要的东西吗？
wallet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

wallet.sentenceEn: The wallet is heading for extinction.
wallet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wallet.sentenceEn: What is happening to the wallet ?
wallet.translationZh: 钱包正在发生什么变化？

wallet.sentenceEn: He feels reluctant to part with the traditional wallet .

worldwide.sentenceEn: I believe taking drug timing into account could help make treatments more effective and help more people worldwide .
worldwide.translationZh: 我相信，将用药时机纳入考量有助于提高治疗效果，并造福全球更多的人。
worldwide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

worldwide.sentenceEn: My colleagues and I wondered whether midazolam, the most common sedative(镇静剂) used in surgical procedures worldwide , might interfere with the internal clock that protects the heart at night.
worldwide.translationZh: 我和同事们都在思考，咪达唑仑作为全球手术中最常用的镇静剂，是否会干扰夜间保护心脏的生物钟。
worldwide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

worldwide.sentenceEn: The platform will allow refugees worldwide to take thousands of online courses for free.
worldwide.translationZh: 该平台将允许全球难民免费学习数千门在线课程。
worldwide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

worldwide.sentenceEn: Despite these problems, however, shrimp continues to be among the most popular sea foods worldwide .
worldwide.translationZh: 然而，尽管存在这些问题，虾仍然是全球最受欢迎的海鲜之一。
worldwide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

worldwide.sentenceEn: It is reported that depression results in enormous economic losses worldwide .
worldwide.translationZh: 据报道，抑郁症在全球范围内造成了巨大的经济损失。

worldwide.sentenceEn: They are vital to reducing waste worldwide .
worldwide.translationZh: 它们对于减少全球浪费至关重要。

warming.sentenceEn: Earth Day now brings together citizens and activists from around the world to raise awareness and take action regarding such environmental concerns as global warming and renewable energy.
warming.translationZh: 现在，地球日汇聚了来自世界各地的民众和活动人士，共同提高公众意识，并针对全球变暖和可再生能源等环境问题采取行动。
warming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

warming.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, the crisis of global warming has already had a serious negative impact on cacao farms' yields, leading to the prices of chocolates skyrocketing.
warming.translationZh: 不幸的是，全球变暖危机已对可可农场的产量造成严重负面影响，导致巧克力价格飙升。
warming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

warming.sentenceEn: Scientists believe that both of these countries will experience a 3.8°F temperature increase by 2050 due to global warming , endangering the cacao(可可树) farms in the rainforests.
warming.translationZh: 科学家认为，受全球变暖影响，到2050年这两个国家的气温都将上升3.8华氏度，这将危及热带雨林中的可可树种植园。
warming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

warming.sentenceEn: How those decreases will be felt will depend on the degree of warming and the crop in question, but in general, "anything over about 30℃ is very bad for crops," says Wolfram Schlenker, an associate professor of international and public affairs at Columbia University.
warming.translationZh: 这些减产带来的影响将取决于气候变暖的程度以及所涉及的农作物种类，但总体而言，"超过30℃左右的温度对农作物非常不利，"哥伦比亚大学国际与公共事务副教授沃尔夫拉姆·施伦克尔说道。

warming.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the cacao farms in the crisis of global warming ?
warming.translationZh: 在全球变暖的危机中，我们对可可农场有哪些了解？

warming.sentenceEn: Global warming is the more accurate term.
warming.translationZh: 全球变暖是更准确的术语。

widespread.sentenceEn: W: Actually, it was a quarter of people, so the problem really is widespread and deserves attention.
widespread.translationZh: 事实上，涉及的人数占了四分之一，所以这个问题确实非常普遍，值得关注。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

widespread.sentenceEn: A substantial part of this, they report, is " widespread ageism" on the part of hiring managers.
widespread.translationZh: 他们报告称，其中的一个重要原因是招聘经理中普遍存在的“年龄歧视”。

widespread.sentenceEn: Such corporate sponsorship is widespread in some fields.
widespread.translationZh: 这种企业赞助在某些领域十分普遍。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

widespread.sentenceEn: It's a significant problem, especially since loneliness is emerging as a widespread public health problem in many countries.
widespread.translationZh: 这是一个重大问题，尤其是在许多国家，孤独感正逐渐成为一个普遍的公共健康问题。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

widespread.sentenceEn: What is the widespread misunderstanding about math anxiety?
widespread.translationZh: 关于数学焦虑，普遍存在的误解是什么？

widespread.sentenceEn: It is now too widespread to be neglected.
widespread.translationZh: 它（肥胖）现在已经非常普遍，不容忽视。

wisdom.sentenceEn: Some people have said aging is more a slide into forgetfulness than a journey towards wisdom .
wisdom.translationZh: 有人说，衰老与其说是通向智慧的旅程，不如说是滑向健忘的过程。
wisdom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wisdom.sentenceEn: I've read some financial education books, done some online learning, and have spoken to my nearest and dearest for their pearls of financial wisdom .
wisdom.translationZh: 我读过一些金融教育书籍，参加过一些在线学习，也向我的至亲好友请教过他们宝贵的财务智慧。
wisdom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

wisdom.sentenceEn: They are about combining your inner wisdom with the knowledge of systematic data to make the best decisions.
wisdom.translationZh: 它们关乎将你的内在智慧与系统性数据知识相结合，以做出最佳决策。
wisdom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

wisdom.sentenceEn: The phenomenon is often referred to as the Matthew effect, inspired by the Bible's wisdom that to those who have, more will be given.
wisdom.translationZh: 这种现象通常被称为马太效应，其灵感源自《圣经》中的智慧：凡有的，还要加给他。

wisdom.sentenceEn: In the show, Marie Kondo acts as a tiny garbage fairy for messy people, visiting their houses to share the wisdom of the "KonMari" method.
wisdom.translationZh: 在节目中，近藤典子就像是一位专门为生活杂乱者服务的整理精灵，她走访这些人的家，分享"近藤式整理法"的智慧。
wisdom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

wisdom.sentenceEn: Their wisdom grows as time goes by.
wisdom.translationZh: 他们的智慧随着时间的推移而增长。

waiter.sentenceEn: The waiter found a bank envelope while cleaning off a table last Saturday at a restaurant.
waiter.translationZh: 上周六，这位服务员在一家餐厅清理餐桌时发现了一个银行信封。
waiter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

waiter.sentenceEn: The waiter , who's working his way through school, did accept the customer's apology and gratitude and said he was happy to have helped her.
waiter.translationZh: 这位正在勤工俭学的服务员确实接受了顾客的道歉和感谢，并表示很高兴能帮到她。
waiter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

waiter.sentenceEn: The customer did not tip the waiter after her meal.
waiter.translationZh: 这位顾客餐后并没有给服务员小费。
waiter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

waiter.sentenceEn: A waiter has returned a check worth nearly $424,000 to the retired social worker who lost it.
waiter.translationZh: 一名服务员将一张价值近42.4万美元的支票归还给了那位丢失支票的退休社会工作者。
waiter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

waiter.sentenceEn: What does the news report say about the waiter ?
waiter.translationZh: 这篇新闻报道关于这位服务员说了些什么？

waiter.sentenceEn: Invite the waiter to a fancy dinner.
waiter.translationZh: 请这位服务员吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

worried.sentenceEn: It is also cheap, at a time when many are worried about what the economic future holds.
worried.translationZh: 在当下许多人对经济前景感到担忧之际，它的价格也很实惠。
worried.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

worried.sentenceEn: Oh, you must be worried that online payments aren't secure.
worried.translationZh: 哦，您一定是担心在线支付不安全吧。
worried.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

worried.sentenceEn: Adults are worried when technological change starts to undermine traditional relationships, particularly the parent-child relationship.
worried.translationZh: 当技术变革开始削弱传统关系，尤其是亲子关系时，成年人便会感到担忧。
worried.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

worried.sentenceEn: Yet factory bosses in many developed countries are worried about a lack of skilled human workers—and see automation and robots as a solution.
worried.translationZh: 然而，许多发达国家的工厂老板却在为熟练工人短缺而担忧——并将自动化和机器人视为解决之道。
worried.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

worried.sentenceEn: What are some people worried about according to the speaker?
worried.translationZh: 根据说话者的说法，一些人在担心什么？

worried.sentenceEn: She is worried about traffic jams.

wage.sentenceEn: In addition to people being healthier and living much longer, economists say that a combination of financial considerations such as years of slow rise in real wages and a shift away from traditional pensions in the private sector are some of the reasons people delay retirement.
wage.translationZh: 经济学家表示，除了人们身体更健康、寿命更长之外，由于实际工资增长多年停滞，以及私营部门从传统养老金制度转型等经济因素的共同作用，也是导致人们推迟退休的部分原因。
wage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

wage.sentenceEn: But by 2013 the average hourly wage for ordinary workers had fallen 5 percent from the 1973 level in terms of actual purchasing power.
wage.translationZh: 但到2013年，以实际购买力计算，普通工人的平均时薪较1973年水平下降了5%。

wage.sentenceEn: According to Friedman, between 1947 and 1973 the average hourly wage for normal workers (those who were not in management roles) in private industries other than agriculture nearly doubled in terms of what their money could buy.
wage.translationZh: 根据弗里德曼的研究，1947年至1973年间，农业以外的私营行业普通工人（非管理岗位）的平均时薪，按购买力计算几乎翻了一番。

wage.sentenceEn: These experts argue that focusing on wage is the wrong approach.
wage.translationZh: 这些专家认为，将重点放在工资奖励上是错误的做法。
wage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

wage.sentenceEn: Researchers have shown that body mass index is related to wages and income.
wage.translationZh: 研究人员已证实，体重指数与薪资收入相关。
wage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

wage.sentenceEn: The rate of wage increase in terms of purchasing power has slowed down for years.
wage.translationZh: 以购买力衡量的工资增长率已持续多年放缓。

wander.sentenceEn: It concluded that pandas fail to wander off in search of new mates if they find their habitat too comfortable, resulting in a lack of vital genetic diversity.
wander.translationZh: 研究得出结论，若大熊猫觉得栖息地过于舒适，它们便不会离开去寻找新的配偶，从而导致关键遗传多样性的缺乏。
wander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wander.sentenceEn: An Asda store in Wales is now home to five cats after they wandered in and made themselves comfortable.
wander.translationZh: 威尔士的一家阿斯达超市如今成了五只猫咪的家，它们溜进店里后便在此安了家。
wander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wander.sentenceEn: Security officers were searching a suburb in Australia where an adult snake was believed to be wandering after the discovery of a huge, "freshly shed" snake skin.
wander.translationZh: 在发现一张巨大的“刚脱落的”蛇皮后，安保人员正搜查澳大利亚的一个郊区，据信那里有一条成年蛇在游荡。
wander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wander.sentenceEn: The elephant wandered out of the jungle and fell into the well.
wander.translationZh: 大象走出丛林，掉进了井里。
wander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

wander.sentenceEn: People may find it more pleasant to wander around streets redesigned for cycling and walking.
wander.translationZh: 人们可能会发现，在专为骑行和步行重新设计的街道上漫步会更加惬意。

wander.sentenceEn: They found an elephant wandering around a well.
wander.translationZh: 他们发现一头大象在一口井边徘徊。

wildlife.sentenceEn: It is not a moment too soon that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test, given that for decades children have been able to name more video game characters than wildlife species.
wildlife.translationZh: 青少年将能参加自然历史测试，这一举措可谓恰逢其时——毕竟数十年来，孩子们能叫出名字的电子游戏角色一直比野生动物种类还要多。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

wildlife.sentenceEn: Numerous documentaries have shown how plastic is ultimately killing wildlife .
wildlife.translationZh: 众多纪录片展示了塑料最终如何导致野生动物死亡。

wildlife.sentenceEn: These farms will then have to be shifted to cooler mountainous areas, which are the natural habitat of wildlife .
wildlife.translationZh: 这些农场将不得不迁往更凉爽的山区，而那里正是野生动物的自然栖息地。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

wildlife.sentenceEn: This will lead to some tough decisions: whether to grow chocolate or save wildlife .
wildlife.translationZh: 这将导致一些艰难的抉择：是种植巧克力还是保护野生动物。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

wildlife.sentenceEn: What will the wildlife management company do with the captured raccoon?
wildlife.translationZh: 野生动物管理公司将如何处理这只被捕获的浣熊？

wildlife.sentenceEn: The natural habitat of wildlife there would be ruined.
wildlife.translationZh: 那里野生动物的自然栖息地将会遭到破坏。

written.sentenceEn: Such differences in value that different working cultures place on the written word tend to cause many problems when it comes to business relationships.
written.translationZh: 不同工作文化对书面文字的重视程度存在差异，这往往会在商业关系中引发诸多问题。
written.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

written.sentenceEn: A person's word is linked to their honor, so verbal agreements are seen as important, whereas written contracts are taken as memos of understanding.
written.translationZh: 一个人的承诺与其名誉息息相关，因此口头协议被视为至关重要，而书面合同则仅被视作理解备忘录。
written.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

written.sentenceEn: Western working culture tends to place a high value on the written word, and this reaches its highest level of intensity when it comes to contracts.
written.translationZh: 西方职场文化往往高度重视书面文字，而这种重视在合同方面达到了顶峰。
written.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

written.sentenceEn: Communication can essentially be divided into two categories: the written and the spoken.
written.translationZh: 沟通从本质上可分为两类：书面沟通和口头沟通。
written.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

written.sentenceEn: How does a Japanese firm tend to view a written contract?
written.translationZh: 日本公司通常如何看待书面合同？

written.sentenceEn: It regards written contracts as unalterable.
written.translationZh: 它（西方工作文化）视书面合同为不可更改的文件。

wireless.sentenceEn: Back in June, the Federal Communications Commission fined AT&T $100 million over accusations that the carrier secretly reduced wireless speeds after customers consumed a certain amount of data.
wireless.translationZh: 早在6月，美国联邦通信委员会就对AT&T处以1亿美元罚款，原因是该公司被指控在用户消耗一定量的数据后秘密降低无线网速。
wireless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wireless.sentenceEn: But the growing popularity of electronic medical records has forced hospital-based doctors to become dependent on computers throughout the day, and desktops—which keep doctors from bedsides—are fast giving way to wireless devices.
wireless.translationZh: 但随着电子病历的日益普及，医院医生不得不全天依赖电脑工作，而那些让医生无法随时在病床边的台式电脑，正迅速被无线设备所取代。
wireless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

wireless.sentenceEn: If they detect something wrong while the system is armed, they'll transmit a wireless alert signal to a base station that will then raise the alarm.
wireless.translationZh: 当系统处于布防状态时，如果这些传感器检测到异常情况，就会向基站发送无线警报信号，基站随后会触发警报。

wireless.sentenceEn: Wireless security providers will often take steps to help combat the threat of jamming attacks.
wireless.translationZh: 无线安全系统提供商通常会采取措施来帮助应对信号干扰攻击的威胁。

wireless.sentenceEn: Interfering with a wireless security system is similar to interfering with a conversation.
wireless.translationZh: 干扰无线安全系统类似于干扰对话。

wireless.sentenceEn: Can Burglars Jam Your Wireless Security System?
wireless.translationZh: 窃贼能干扰你的无线安全系统吗？

wooden.sentenceEn: One can also paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls, helping the rooms look bigger.
wooden.translationZh: 你也可以将木质框架漆成与墙壁相同的颜色，这样能让房间看起来更大。
wooden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

wooden.sentenceEn: It fell through the wooden floorboards, apparently lost forever.
wooden.translationZh: 戒指从木地板的缝隙中掉落，显然已经永远遗失了。
wooden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

wooden.sentenceEn: Recently, the restaurant manager Ryan Krivoy decided to replace the wooden deck and he found an old gold coin, some $100 bills and a silver wedding ring while replacing the deck.
wooden.translationZh: 最近，餐厅经理瑞安·克里沃伊决定更换木质地板，在更换过程中，他发现了一枚古老的金币、一些百元美钞和一枚银质婚戒。
wooden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

wooden.sentenceEn: The restaurant was built on a wooden structure above the sea-water.
wooden.translationZh: 这家餐厅建在一个木质结构上，俯瞰着海水。
wooden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

wooden.sentenceEn: My secretary told me you were having some problems with the wooden table.
wooden.translationZh: 我的秘书告诉我您的木质餐桌有些问题。
wooden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

wooden.sentenceEn: Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour.
wooden.translationZh: 将木质框架与墙壁漆成同一种颜色。

wave.sentenceEn: A phantom jam begins when a car in dense traffic slows down even slightly, which causes the car behind that vehicle to slow even more—and the slowing action spreads backward through the lane of traffic like a wave , getting worse the farther it spreads.
wave.translationZh: 幽灵堵车始于拥堵车流中的一辆车轻微减速，这导致其后方车辆减速更甚——这种减速行为像波浪一样在车道中向后传播，传播得越远，拥堵就越严重。

wave.sentenceEn: Parental financial support of early adults, said Ken Dychtwald, CEO of Age Wave , is "the new normal".
wave.translationZh: Age Wave公司首席执行官肯·迪希瓦尔德表示，父母对成年初期子女的经济支持已成为“新常态”。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

wave.sentenceEn: In a new Merrill Lynch/Age Wave survey, a full 70% of the early adults said they received financial support from their parents in the past year and 58% said they couldn't afford their current lifestyles without it.
wave.translationZh: 在美林证券与Age Wave联合开展的一项新调查中，高达70%的年轻人表示他们在过去一年中获得了父母的经济支持，58%的人承认若没有这种支持，他们无法维持当前的生活方式。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wave.sentenceEn: The U.S. was founded by successive waves of immigrants, and immigrants are still contributing to America today—statistics prove it.
wave.translationZh: 美国是由一波又一波的移民建立起来的，如今移民仍在为美国做出贡献——这一事实有数据为证。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wave.sentenceEn: What do we learn from a new survey by Merrill Lynch/Age Wave ?
wave.translationZh: 我们能从美林证券/时代浪潮的新调查中学到什么？

wave.sentenceEn: Another wave of immigrants is hitting the U.S.
wave.translationZh: 又一波移民潮正在涌入美国。

web.sentenceEn: Do you prefer to fill out an application on the web , or to print it out and fill it in by hand and then post it back to us?
web.translationZh: 您更倾向于在线填写申请表，还是打印出来手写后邮寄给我们？
web.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

web.sentenceEn: The next day Kate asked if she could check the shipping status, so her mom clicked on the web page and then walked out of the room.
web.translationZh: 第二天，凯特问妈妈能不能查看一下物流状态，于是妈妈点开网页，然后便走出了房间。
web.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

web.sentenceEn: The spoken web could also help the one-in-five adults in Europe and the U.S. with poor reading skills.
web.translationZh: 语音网络还可以帮助欧美五分之一存在阅读障碍的成年人。

web.sentenceEn: But building the spoken web —web-to-voice and voice-to-web—isn't straightforward.
web.translationZh: 但是构建语音网络——即网页转语音和语音转网页——并非易事。

web.sentenceEn: They are often denied crucial information the web offers many others.
web.translationZh: 他们往往无法获取网络为其他人提供的关键信息。

web.sentenceEn: The spoken web is helpful when one's hands are occupied.
web.translationZh: 当双手被占用时，语音网络很有用。

wellbeing.sentenceEn: Across all three, parenthood was associated with more positive wellbeing outcomes for dads than for mums.
wellbeing.translationZh: 在所有三项研究中，为人父母对父亲幸福感的积极影响均大于母亲。
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: "This difference suggests that how mothers and fathers spend time with their children might have important implications for their wellbeing ," the authors write.
wellbeing.translationZh: 作者写道：“这种差异表明，父母与子女相处的方式可能对他们的幸福感产生重要影响。”
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: These are much better and much more productive ways for companies to move forward on their employees' wellbeing .
wellbeing.translationZh: 对于企业改善员工福祉而言，这些是更好、更有成效的方法。
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: A new study carried out by the University of Lincoln has found a link between the personalities of cat owners and the behaviour and wellbeing of their cats.
wellbeing.translationZh: 林肯大学开展的一项新研究发现，猫主人的性格与他们猫咪的行为及健康状况之间存在关联。
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: You may not actually experience emotional wellbeing at home if you remain occupied with what happened at work.
wellbeing.translationZh: 如果你一直纠结于工作中发生的事情，那么在家可能无法真正感受到情绪健康。

wellbeing.sentenceEn: People's psychological wellbeing is related to various factors.
wellbeing.translationZh: 人们的心理健康与多种因素相关。

whereas.sentenceEn: Yet whereas most countries have detailed, evidence-backed guidelines on the type and intensity of exercise required for various physical health benefits, such guidelines do not yet exist for exercise and mood.
whereas.translationZh: 然而，尽管大多数国家都有详细的、有证据支持的指南，规定了获得各种身体健康益处所需的运动类型和强度，但针对运动与情绪的此类指南尚未问世。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

whereas.sentenceEn: Nowadays, men eat an approximate average of 140 grams of bread daily, whereas women eat 80 to 90 grams.
whereas.translationZh: 如今，男性平均每天食用约140克面包，而女性则食用80至90克。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

whereas.sentenceEn: A person's word is linked to their honor, so verbal agreements are seen as important, whereas written contracts are taken as memos of understanding.
whereas.translationZh: 一个人的承诺与其名誉息息相关，因此口头协议被视为至关重要，而书面合同则仅被视作理解备忘录。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

whereas.sentenceEn: Whereas people with tooth sensitivity may complain, for example, of tooth pain triggered by heat or cold, the nerves in the inner layer don't sense temperature.
whereas.translationZh: 虽然牙齿敏感的人可能会抱怨，例如，牙齿因热或冷而引发疼痛，但内层的神经其实并不感知温度。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

whereas.sentenceEn: The second is guaranteed to look great for about 10 years, whereas the cheaper one will start to dull after around six or seven years.
whereas.translationZh: 贵的那款保证十年内都能保持美观，而便宜的那款大概六七年后就会开始褪色。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

whereas.sentenceEn: Fantasy proneness could be considered a tendency to imagine and daydream, whereas absorption is the tendency to allow your mind to become fully absorbed in an activity—to pay complete attention to the sensations(感受) and the experiences.
whereas.translationZh: 幻想倾向可被视为一种想象和做白日梦的倾向，而专注力则是让自己全身心投入某项活动的倾向——完全专注于感受和体验。

witness.sentenceEn: The father of two from Columbus, Ohio, who still works at the company as an associate and investigator, said he has witnessed a "domino effect(多米诺效应)" across companies since the settlement, but that there is still substantial progress to be made towards changing attitudes towards paternity leave.
witness.translationZh: 这位来自俄亥俄州哥伦布市的两个孩子的父亲目前仍在该公司担任助理兼调查员。他表示，自和解以来，他目睹了各公司间产生的'多米诺效应'，但在改变人们对陪产假的态度方面仍有很长的路要走。

witness.sentenceEn: Witnessing habits like that can help kids "realize that they can exercise some more control over their devices," she says.
witness.translationZh: 她说，目睹这样的习惯有助于孩子们“认识到他们可以对自己的设备施加更多控制。”
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

witness.sentenceEn: W: Witnesses said people were looking on in horror as the child's mother, identified by sources as Maria Zamara, stood frozen in shock.
witness.translationZh: 女：目击者称，人们惊恐地看着这一幕，而孩子的母亲——据消息人士透露名为玛丽亚·扎马拉——则震惊得呆立当场。
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

witness.sentenceEn: What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month?
witness.translationZh: 不到一个月后，费耶特维尔将会见证什么？

witness.sentenceEn: It witnessed a significant increase in women engineers in the 1970s.
witness.translationZh: 20世纪70年代，女性工程师的数量显著增加。

walking.sentenceEn: The former involves such things as walking , jogging and cycling and means exercising in such a way that your body is able to use oxygen to burn fat for energy.
walking.translationZh: 前者包括步行、慢跑和骑自行车等运动，指的是以身体能够利用氧气燃烧脂肪获取能量的方式进行锻炼。
walking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

walking.sentenceEn: And the best way to get strong, healthy bones is by doing weight-bearing exercises like running, dancing and walking , according to a large study.
walking.translationZh: 一项大型研究表明，获得强健健康骨骼的最佳方式是进行负重运动，如跑步、跳舞和步行。
walking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

walking.sentenceEn: Even better, you set a powerful example because when they see you reaping the benefits of walking , they'll be encouraged to walk more, too.
walking.translationZh: 更妙的是，你还能树立一个积极榜样，因为当他们看到你从散步中获益时，也会受到鼓舞，从而走得更多。
walking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

walking.sentenceEn: Bone density may not be one of the most exciting health benefits of walking , but it's an important one.
walking.translationZh: 骨密度或许不是步行最令人兴奋的健康益处之一，但却是非常重要的一项。
walking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

walking.sentenceEn: People may find it more pleasant to wander around streets redesigned for cycling and walking .
walking.translationZh: 人们可能会发现，在专为骑行和步行重新设计的街道上漫步会更加惬意。

worsen.sentenceEn: Increasing the spacing of vehicles dampens the effect of slowdowns by cars in front of a given car, so that the slowing is not worsened until it becomes a phantom jam, the researchers said.
worsen.translationZh: 研究人员表示，增加车辆之间的间距可以减轻前方车辆减速对当前车辆的影响，从而延缓减速加剧直至形成幽灵堵车的过程。

worsen.sentenceEn: While this can be good news for the world's poorest people who now consume more calories, protein and fat than in the past, homogeneity(同一性) and over-dependence on a handful of staples leave us vulnerable to threats such as drought, disease and pests—all of which are predicted to worsen in many parts of the world as a result of climate change.
worsen.translationZh: 虽然这对世界上最贫困的人群来说可能是个好消息——他们现在摄入的热量、蛋白质和脂肪比过去都有所增加，但饮食的同一性以及对少数几种主食的过度依赖，使我们容易受到干旱、疾病和虫害等威胁的影响。而气候变化预计将导致这些威胁在世界许多地区进一步加剧。

worsen.sentenceEn: Instead, declining grades only predicted worse stress hormones among students who believed that worsening grades were a permanent and hopeless state of affairs.
worsen.translationZh: 相反，只有当学生认为成绩下降是一种永久且无望的状况时，成绩下降才会导致压力荷尔蒙水平升高。

worsen.sentenceEn: Some of the indicators such as income inequality, measured by the Equality of Opportunity Project for the year 2000, have only worsened in the past 16 years.
worsen.translationZh: 一些指标，例如机会平等项目在2000年测量的收入不平等，在过去16年中只变得更加严重。

worsen.sentenceEn: "For several years, the situation of heritage in Venice has been worsening , and it has now reached a dramatic situation," Tabet told UNESCO.
worsen.translationZh: 塔贝特向联合国教科文组织表示：'几年来，威尼斯的遗产状况持续恶化，如今已到了十分严峻的地步。'

worsen.sentenceEn: Their environment for survival has been continuously worsening .
worsen.translationZh: 它们的生存环境一直在持续恶化。

wealthy.sentenceEn: Studies have shown that people who appear to be wealthy tend to be considered more intelligent, disciplined, and competent than those who do not.
wealthy.translationZh: 研究表明，与非富裕人群相比，看起来富裕的人往往被认为更聪明、更自律且更有能力。
wealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

wealthy.sentenceEn: The ability to overcome food shortages that must be built into some of the poorest countries will not come from loans from wealthy countries, which may have food problems of their own, or world economic institutions.
wealthy.translationZh: 一些最贫穷国家必须建立的克服粮食短缺的能力，不会来自富裕国家的贷款——这些国家自身可能也面临粮食问题——也不会来自世界经济机构。
wealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

wealthy.sentenceEn: It even reaches into the middle classes, as real wages have stagnated(不增长) for all but the very wealthy and temporary spells of financial instability are not uncommon.
wealthy.translationZh: 这种不稳定性甚至蔓延至中产阶级，因为除极少数巨富人群外，大多数人的实际工资停滞不前，短暂的财务不稳定也屡见不鲜。

wealthy.sentenceEn: Never afraid to talk up his own accomplishments, a boastful Carême made a fortune as wealthy families with social ambitions invited him to their kitchens.
wealthy.translationZh: 卡雷姆从不避讳宣扬自己的成就，这位略带自夸的厨师凭借着这份自信发了大财——那些有着社交野心的富裕家庭纷纷邀请他到家中掌勺。

wealthy.sentenceEn: Carême became extremely wealthy by cooking for rich and socially ambitious families.
wealthy.translationZh: 卡雷姆通过为富有且有社会抱负的家庭烹饪而变得极为富有。

wealthy.sentenceEn: Wealthy nations should solve their own food problems first.
wealthy.translationZh: 富裕国家应当首先解决自身的粮食问题。

welfare.sentenceEn: This is based on higher earnings and avoided costs in health care, crime, welfare dependence and other things.
welfare.translationZh: 这一结论是基于更高的收入以及在医疗保健、犯罪、福利依赖和其他方面节省的成本。

welfare.sentenceEn: There is a great tension between "the poor" and those who are receiving what has become a dirty word: " welfare ."
welfare.translationZh: "穷人"与那些接受被视为不光彩的"福利"的人之间存在巨大矛盾。

welfare.sentenceEn: On the other hand, 22 percent think we are spending too little on " welfare ": 37 percent believe we are spending too much.
welfare.translationZh: 另一方面，22%的受访者认为我们在“福利”上的支出过少，而37%的人认为我们在这方面支出过多。

welfare.sentenceEn: Air pollution costs the global economy more than $5 trillion annually in welfare costs, with the most serious damage occurring in the developing world.
welfare.translationZh: 空气污染每年给全球经济造成的福利损失超过5万亿美元，其中发展中国家受到的损害最为严重。
welfare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

welfare.sentenceEn: Americans usually overestimate the number of blacks receiving welfare benefits.
welfare.translationZh: 美国人通常高估接受福利救济的黑人数量。

weaken.sentenceEn: Thus, language seems to be a skill that, contrary to what many might assume, does not weaken with age.
weaken.translationZh: 因此，与许多人可能认为的相反，语言似乎是一种不会随着年龄增长而衰退的技能。
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

weaken.sentenceEn: Our eyesight may dim and our recall may weaken , but, by comparison, our ability to produce and to comprehend language is well preserved into older adulthood.
weaken.translationZh: 我们的视力可能会衰退，记忆力可能会减弱，但相比之下，我们的语言生成和理解能力在老年时期仍然保持得很好。
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

weaken.sentenceEn: But too much blue light, especially from electronic devices, can harm our health by weakening our vision and making it harder for us to fall asleep.
weaken.translationZh: 但是过多的蓝光，尤其是来自电子设备的蓝光，会损害我们的健康，它会削弱我们的视力，还会使我们更难入睡。
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

weaken.sentenceEn: Their massive wake creates waves at the bottom of the sea, weakening the foundations of the centuries-old buildings themselves.
weaken.translationZh: 这些巨轮产生的巨大尾流在海底掀起波浪，不断侵蚀着那些有数百年历史的建筑地基。

weaken.sentenceEn: Does that mean the link between lower oil prices and growth has weakened ?
weaken.translationZh: 这是否意味着油价下跌与经济增长之间的关联已经减弱？
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

weaken.sentenceEn: Brain power weakens slower than we imagine.
weaken.translationZh: 脑力衰退的速度比我们想象的要慢。

widely.sentenceEn: That is: American inequality means that the gains of increasing productivity are not widely shared by everyone.
widely.translationZh: 也就是说：美国的不平等意味着生产力提高所带来的收益并未被所有人广泛分享。

widely.sentenceEn: One widely accepted psychological definition of boredom is "the distasteful experience of wanting, but being unable, to engage in satisfying activity."
widely.translationZh: 心理学界广泛接受的对无聊的定义是“一种令人不快的体验：想要却无法参与令人满意的活动。”
widely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

widely.sentenceEn: These microplastics included a substance commonly known as PET and widely used in the manufacture of clothing and food and liquid containers.
widely.translationZh: 这些微塑料中含有一种通常被称为PET的物质，该物质广泛用于制造服装、食品及液体容器。
widely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

widely.sentenceEn: But EdX expects its software to be adopted widely by schools and universities.
widely.translationZh: 但EdX期望其软件能被各类学校和大学广泛采用。

widely.sentenceEn: It is widely considered wrong not to eat breakfast.
widely.translationZh: 人们普遍认为不吃早餐是错误的。

willpower.sentenceEn: I believe the key to success is willpower .
willpower.translationZh: 我认为成功的关键在于意志力。
willpower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

willpower.sentenceEn: People with a great amount of willpower have the discipline to develop positive, successful habits.
willpower.translationZh: 拥有强大意志力的人能够通过自律养成积极且成功的习惯。
willpower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

willpower.sentenceEn: Willpower is the ability to control yourself.
willpower.translationZh: 意志力是控制自己的能力。
willpower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

willpower.sentenceEn: Willpower and habits go hand in hand.
willpower.translationZh: 意志力和习惯相辅相成。
willpower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

willpower.sentenceEn: What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower ?
willpower.translationZh: 作者认为我们需要做什么来增强意志力？

willpower.sentenceEn: They are stronger than men in terms of willpower .
willpower.translationZh: 她们在意志力方面比男性更强。
